no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: OraSure Technologies is a point-of-care diagnostics and sample-collection device company (HIV, HCV, COVID-19, syphilis rapid tests; saliva and microbiome sample collection; CRISPR-based rapid molecular diagnostics via the Sherlock subsidiary). It develops in-vitro diagnostic devices, not therapeutic drug candidates. The 10-K, corporate website, and ClinicalTrials.gov sponsor searches for both OraSure and Sherlock Biosciences disclose no Phase 1/2/3 interventional drug trials. The principal in-development device program is the Sherlock CT/NG IVD, which is in IVD performance/clinical study and was submitted to FDA in late 2025 (recorded under commercial_product.in_development_devices).
